check_names: Full style preserves source labels exactly, including whitespace and identifiers
Compact program labels preserve association and uncertainty
Short program labels remain like/uncertain rather than anatomical assignments
Native cluster and reference identifiers are not automatically removed
Unknown labels are retained and no generic string clipping hides qualifiers
Custom labels are exact source-keyed and retain scientific uncertainty
Absent and blank custom aliases fall back to compact display
Category aliases apply to cluster-prefixed rows and whole-label overrides take precedence
Reference-like and provisional warnings survive custom renaming
Safe hex validation rejects CSS expressions, short values and nonstrings
Native palette preserves known categorical colors
Exact category overrides apply to fixed SL/DL colors under every palette
Palette colors are deterministic and ignore invalid override values
Full source keys keep categories distinct when their short labels collide
Inherited map entries are not treated as a user customization
Display helpers do not mutate source objects, settings maps or memberships
